skills.desc: Removes 1 wrong choice from a tap question. Still works in battle, but does not count toward learning.
At streak 3+, a correct attack hits twice (2nd hit 50%).
Auto: your first broken block in a battle becomes a good block.
Answer a question: correct heals 30% max HP. MP is spent either way. Once per battle.
